\[
J^{1} = G_{\sigma_s} * I,
\qquad
J^{t+1}(p) = \frac{1}{K_p} \sum_{q \in N(p)} e^{-\frac{\lVert p - q \rVert^2}{2\sigma_s^2} - \frac{\lVert J^t(p) - J^t(q) \rVert^2}{2\sigma_r^2}} \, I(q)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): The image
- \(J^t\): The guide after step t
- \(\sigma_s\): The scale
- \(\sigma_r\): The color sigma
- \(K_p\): The sum of the weights at p

I is the image and J the guide. The first step is a Gaussian blur of sigma s, which removes every structure smaller than the scale, and blurs large edges too. Each further step is a joint bilateral filter of the original image. Neighbors q weigh by their distance from p, and by how close the guide's colors at p and q are. K p is the sum of the weights. Where the blurred guide still shows a large edge, the weights follow it, and the edge comes back sharp from I. Small structures were wiped from the guide, so nothing brings them back. That is the rolling of the guidance.
